integrity: The proof uses the standard metric property of energy distance and the Borsuk--Ulam theorem. Classical manifold-width and deterministic-autoencoder topological obstructions are treated as prior structure; the claimed contribution is the explicit cap-integrated population energy-score floor for stochastic conditional-law prediction and its necessary Lipschitz blow-up consequence.
scientific limitations: The theorem is a population lower bound for a translation family with covariates uniform on a sphere. Its constant is certified but not claimed minimax-sharp. It requires a Lipschitz encoder and uniform Lipschitz control of the generator in the encoded coordinate; discontinuous encoders are outside scope. It does not address optimization or finite-sample estimation error.
title: A quantitative energy-score bottleneck for Lipschitz distributional reduction
